                                SHARE CERTIFICATE


Certificate Number: 002                               Number of Shares: 123,750

     This Certifies that HONG YANG is the registered holder of ONE HUNDRED

signed by its duly authorized officers and its Corporate Seal to be hereunto
affixed.

     This 16th day of December, 1999.
